items.title: 27.2.1 Banawat ke lihaz se proteins ki taqseem (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure-based classification of proteins (PDF 164-166).

blocks.text: Proteins amino acids ki seedhi (linear) zanjeerein hain jo peptide bonds se juri hoti hain. Peptide bond aik amide bond hai: jab aik amino acid ka –COO⁻ group saath wale amino acid ke –NH₃⁺ group se react karta hai to yeh bond banta hai aur aik lambi seedhi polymer zanjeer ban jati hai. Bohat se peptide linkages se bani amino acids ki lambi zanjeeron ko polypeptide chains kehte hain. Har protein ki apni khaas polypeptide chains hoti hain jo us ki banawat aur kaam tay karti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne amino group ko '-NH³⁺' chhapa hai. Sahi likhawat –NH₃⁺ hai: nitrogen par teen hydrogen atoms (neeche chhota 3) aur aik positive charge (oopar +).

Kisi jaandaar mein protein ke pecheeda kaam ko samajhne ke liye us ki polypeptide chain ki teen-dimensional (3D) shakal jaanna zaroori hai. Proteins ki banawat ke chaar darje (levels) hain: primary, secondary, tertiary aur quaternary.

Primary structure: polypeptide chain mein peptide bonds se jure amino acids ki khaas tarteeb (sequence) primary structure hai. Yahi tarteeb tay karti hai ke protein mur kar kaisi 3D shakal banayega, aur shakal hi us ka biological kaam tay karti hai. Sirf aik amino acid badalne se bhi protein ki banawat badal kar us ka kaam kharab ho sakta hai. Maslan albumin (kitab ke mutabiq taqreeban 400 amino acids) aur insulin jaise proteins theek kaam ke liye apni durust tarteeb par munhasir hain.

Sickle cell anemia aik bimari hai jis mein khoon ke aam laal cells daranti (sickle) ki shakal ke ho jate hain. Yeh haemoglobin ke ghalat banne se hota hai. Sickle cells khoon ki nalein band kar dete hain aur khoon ka aam daur (circulation) bigar dete hain.

blocks.alt: Do amino acids, H2N-CH(R)-COOH aur H2N-CH(R')-COOH; pehle acid ke COOH ka OH aur doosre ke NH2 ka aik H ghere mein hain. Teer dipeptide ki taraf jata hai jis mein darmiyan ka C=O aur N-H dabbe mein 'Peptide linkage' hai, + H2O. Neeche rangeen motiyon (beads) ki lambi lari polypeptide chain ko dikhati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.4: Amino acids ke darmiyan peptide bonds se peptide chain ka banna (kitab ki Figure 27.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle amino acid ke COOH ka OH aur doosre ke NH₂ ka H mil kar paani bante hain; C=O aur N–H ke darmiyan naya C–N bond peptide linkage hai. Kitab ne dono amino acids par R chhapa lekin product mein R aur R'; is liye khaake mein doosre amino acid par R' likha gaya hai taa ke dono taraf aik jaisa ho. Motiyon ki lari mein har moti aik amino acid hai.

Secondary structure: jab protein ki zanjeer ke backbone (reerh) ke atoms aapas mein hydrogen bonds banate hain to ba-qaida namoone (regular patterns) bante hain, jaise α-helix aur β-pleated sheet. α-helix mein hydrogen bonds aik hi zanjeer ke saath saath bante hain aur zanjeer spring ki tarah lipat jati hai (maslan keratin). β-pleated sheet mein hydrogen bonds saath saath pari zanjeeron ke darmiyan bante hain aur tah-dar chadar jaisi shakal banti hai (maslan resham ka fibroin), jaisa Figure 27.5 mein hai.
Yeh tarteebein protein ko mazbooti (stability) aur lachak (flexibility) deti hain aur us ki poori 3D shakal banane mein hissa leti hain, jo us ke khaas kaam ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: beta pleated sheet ki teen zanjeerein tah-dar (pleated) chadar par; carbon, oxygen, nitrogen aur hydrogen atoms aur R group side chains, aur aik zanjeer ke C=O aur agli ke N-H ke darmiyan tooti lakeeron (dashes) wale hydrogen bonds. Legend: carbon, oxygen, nitrogen, R group side chain, hydrogen, hydrogen bond. Neeche: alpha-helix ka feeta (ribbon) jis ke cheron (turns) ke darmiyan C=O...H-N hai, aur saath note.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.5: Primary amino acid zanjeeron se alpha-helix aur beta pleated sheets ka banna (kitab ki Figure 27.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Helix ke saath note: helix ke chakkar C=O aur N-H groups ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se thame hain; har chakkar 3-4 hydrogen bonds se agle chakkar se jura hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beta pleated sheet mein hydrogen bonds (neeli tooti lakeerein) aik zanjeer ke C=O aur saath wali zanjeer ke N–H ke darmiyan hain, is liye zanjeerein chadar ki tarah jur jati hain. Alpha-helix mein yeh bonds aik hi zanjeer ke aik chakkar ke C=O aur agle chakkar ke N–H ke darmiyan hain. R groups sheet ki tahon (folds) se oopar neeche nikalte hain.

Tertiary structure protein ki poori 3D shakal hai jo tab banti hai jab polypeptide chain apne side chains (R-groups) ke darmiyan quwwaton ki wajah se mur jati hai. Yeh quwwatein hain: hydrogen bonds, ionic bonds, hydrophobic interactions (paani se door rehne wale hisson ka aapas mein jurna) aur disulphide bridges (S–S jor). In ki wajah se zanjeer bal kha kar aik khaas shakal banati hai, aksar gol (globular) protein. Yahi 3D shakal protein ka kaam tay karti hai. Maslan enzymes mein active site ki theek shakal hi substrate ko jurne deti hai aur reaction tez karti hai. Is shakal mein koi bhi tabdeeli enzyme ki activity par asar dalti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: motiyon ki lari jis ke shuru par teer hai, Primary structure: zanjeer mein amino acids ke jurne ki tarteeb. Peele teer alpha-helix aur beta-pleated sheet tak jate hain, Secondary structure: primary structure ka lipatna ya tah hona. Aage teer helices, sheets aur loops wali mudi zanjeer tak, Tertiary structure: mudi zanjeer ki poori teen dimension ki shakal.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.6: Primary amino acid zanjeeron se proteins ki tertiary structure tak (kitab ki Figure 27.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeron ki tarteeb dekhein: primary structure (amino acids ki lari) mur kar secondary structure (alpha-helix ya beta-sheet) banati hai, aur yeh mazeed mur kar tertiary structure ki gathi shakal banate hain. Kitab ne tertiary ke neeche bhi wahi jumla chhapa jo secondary ke neeche hai; tertiary structure muri hui zanjeer ki poori 3D shakal hai (kitab ki apni ta'reef), is liye khaake mein yahi likha gaya.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Kuch proteins ki quaternary structure bhi hoti hai. Yeh tab banti hai jab do ya zyada muri hui polypeptide chains (subunits) aapas mein jur jati hain: hydrogen bonds, ionic (salt) bridges, hydrophobic interactions aur kabhi disulphide bonds ke zariye.
Tertiary ya quaternary structure banne ke baad proteins ki jo poori shakal banti hai, us ke lihaz se inhein do bari qismon mein baanta jata hai:

Fibrous proteins: in ke molecules lambe, chhar jaise ya dhaage jaise hote hain. In ki polypeptide chains saath saath (parallel) chalti hain aur mazboot hydrogen bonds ya disulphide bonds se jur kar fibres (reshe) banati hain. Yeh aam taur par paani mein nahi ghulte, mazboot aur stable hote hain, is liye jism mein dhaancha banane wale polymers ka kaam karte hain. Misalein: collagen (connective tissue), keratin (baal, nakhun, jild) aur myosin (muscle). Baalon ka keratin aur resham ka fibroin fibrous proteins hain.

Globular proteins: agar poora protein molecule gol ya ande jaisa (ovoid) ho to woh globular protein hai. Zyada tar kaam karne wale (functional) proteins, jaise enzymes, hormones aur ghizai proteins, globular hain. Globular proteins garmi aur pH se jaldi mutasir hote hain. Anday ki safedi garam karne par sakht ho jati hai kyun ke zanjeeron ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds toot jate hain aur zanjeerein khul jati hain. Isi wajah se doodh ka protein casein lemon ka ras dalne se, jab pH badalta hai, jam jata (coagulate ho jata) hai. Is amal ko proteins ka denaturing kehte hain.
Anday ki safedi globular protein hai.

blocks.prompt: Alpha-helix ko us ki shakal mein kaun thaamta hai?
blocks.explanation: Aik peptide link ke C=O aur usi zanjeer mein chand amino acids aage wale peptide link ke N–H ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds.

items: Primary: amino acids ki tarteeb (peptide bonds).
Secondary: α-helix aur β-pleated sheet (backbone ke hydrogen bonds); tertiary: R-groups ki quwwaton se murna; quaternary: kai zanjeerein.
Fibrous (collagen, keratin, myosin) aur globular (enzymes, hormones); garmi ya pH se denaturing.
